scope: Round-5 integration of m5-brake, m5-brain12, m5-arches and m5-safety on branch m5 (from m4b 2a5bccb). Development evidence only: open-loop replays of 27 live logs every round-5 branch had read, the descent surrogate and the motor-assist harness (synthetic walls and looming). Nothing flown.

tests.final: 1204 passed in 242.02 s on ac16bb8 (the integration commit adds only documents)

replays.harness: m5 tree haltere/obstacles/vertical_replay.py, run from each replayed tree (git archives of m4b 2a5bccb and m5 96750a3; the m5 flight-stack variant re-run on ac16bb8 equals it in every array of all 27 logs); Straw laps and pine-brain08-01 with the offline looming stream (scratchpad m4/vguard/streams, the sha256 of configs/pilot/safety_gates.json)

variants.m4b: --stack on --near-on-path --throttle-column command_thr --descent-view configs/pilot/descent_view.json (m4b tree: wall v5, descent view v2)
variants.shares: m5 without --stale-evidence; without --motor-assist; with --wall-pilot wall_pilot_v5.json; with --descent-view descent_view_v2.json; with --contact-support shadow
variants.identity: --stack none, --stack shadow --near-on-path on both trees; m5 with wall v5 and descent view v2 and no round-5 rule vs m4b; m5 with/without --motor-assist on the fast-PD logs

surrogate.note: descent_rehearsal.run_batch, the descent gates profile, 150 s. dev: flat/steep 3000-3007, hill 6000-6011, sim seed 17 (the m4b rows of the fast PD and fast-brain-11 are round 4b's integration runs; fast-brain-12-b-cw26d3 has m4b rows on the fresh sets only); fresh: hill 6700-6711, steep 7700-7707, sim seed 53 (never used before)

harness.note: motor_assist_eval.run_scenarios: v1 sets (seed 23), v3 hairpins (seed 41), fresh hairpins turn 55/85/120 x arch 9.5/13.5 x wall 2.2/2.65 (seed 67, never used before), the same with live-like wall samples, and the v3 pass-through report set (seed 41). m4beq = the m5 tree with the kept wall v5 and descent view v2 and no round-5 rule
